The failure is related to the CMAESOptimizer class in the package org.apache.commons.math3.optimization.direct. The test fails at line 477 in CMAESOptimizerTest, where it checks that the optimization result near the upper bound is very close (within 1e-3) to the result with no bounds. Instead, the value near the upper bound is 8.0, while the expected is about 11.1, indicating the optimizer is not handling the upper bound correctly or the optimization is stopping prematurely.
